basis: The Kunsthalle's about page says it is part of the Kulturamt and its footer reads that it is an institution of the City of Münster; the Kulturamt page lists the Kunsthalle's head among its team.
The imprint says the house is an institution of the City of Oldenburg and its footer calls it an exhibition house of the city.

governance.parent: City of Recklinghausen, Fachbereich 41, Städtische Museen

basis: The city's Fachbereich 41 page lists the Städtische Museen, which include the Kunsthalle, as unit 41/6, and the Kunsthalle imprint names the Museen der Stadt Recklinghausen as responsible.

The statutes dated 16 December 2010 (pages 1 to 4, sections 1, 7 to 9 and 12) say the state set up the foundation under public law, the Foundation Board of three ministry representatives appoints the director and establishes the plans, and the state audit office may examine the accounts.

The statutes of April 2023 (sections 1, 7, 9 and 10) make it a registered association whose Beirat, with council and city representatives on a search commission, hires the artistic director and fixes the budget.

The statutes on the association's site (sections 1, 10 and 12) give the Verwaltungsrat the appointment of directors and approval of the annual business plan, and let the directors hire staff up to pay grade 9 TV-L.
The museum site's credits page names Vitra Design Stiftung gGmbH, entered as HRB 413299 at the Amtsgericht Freiburg, with the managing directors and the museum director.

The museum's imprint (archived December 2025) names Kunststiftung Volkswagen, a foundation with legal capacity under civil law in the foundation register, under the supervising authority Amt für regionale Landesentwicklung Braunschweig, and the about page calls the museum privately sponsored and financed by that foundation.
